refutation_skeptics._doc: M13 refutation-by-majority fan-out (#1943). This projection lets scripts/check-agent-dispatch.mjs detect drift in the refutation skill's documented N table. Solo XS/S = 1; Standard = 3; gated-review raises to the full vertical set (tier_verticals.Standard).

model_diversity._doc: Cross-model review seats per tier (#2358). Standard reserves one Codex seat; XS/S retain an Anthropic baseline. scripts/check-agent-dispatch.mjs asserts parity with externalSlotsForTier and bounds the value by REVIEW_AGENTS.
